content.short: web3cli is a command-line tool for performing blockchain operations from the terminal.
content.description: web3cli is a terminal-based command-line tool that lets you perform common blockchain operations without a frontend. It supports swapping or minting, automating DeFi yield collection and reinvestment, and scheduling buy or sell orders on a DEX, as well as on-chain data analysis. It currently supports EVM-compatible chains out of the box, with token and contract support planned for the future. This tool is aimed at crypto enthusiasts who need scriptable, direct blockchain access, including DeFi users, NFT fans, Web3 gamers, and chain analysts.
